Pax Renaissance 2nd edition by Phil & Matt Eklund

[b]Rules:[/b] TBD

Module by Samuelw

[b]Setup Notes:[/b]
1. Scripted setup: Select Number of players.
2. Player order is randomized starting. If Fugger is in play, Fugger goes first.

[b]Solitaire [/b] setup when clicking 1 player. (Setup will change to Blue and another random (bot) player.
[b]Manual[/b] Setup randomizes the cards then removes the setup tile.

[b]Map Cards[/b]Map cards have 4 states. 1. Medieval, 2, Catholic, 3. Protestant, 4. Islam
[b]Empire Ownership Tokens[/b] can be used to remind who controls various empires. 

[b]Return Platform[/b] Easily returns pieces, coins, cards, just drop items on platform and wait a few seconds.
•Pawns dropped on the return platform will be returned below the player cards.
•Drop items onto the grey return platform for easy  cleanup. 
•Dropping empire cards will return them with the selected rotation and remove Empire ownership tokens at that location.
•Tableau cards will be placed in discard stacks to the left of the market.

[b]Victory cards[/b] are locked, press “L” to unlock before flipping. 

Emperor cards can be placed on top of queen card, then use attach tool (f6) to connect the two cards. To detach, use attach tool (f6) to disconnect later, by dragging from the first card to no other card.

function loadGlobalData()
	local ind = {}
	local bodyText = ""
	local found = false
	local notebooks = Notes.getNotebookTabs()
	for k,v in pairs(notebooks) do
		if v.title == "HardSaveData" then
			ind = v.index
			bodyText = v.body
			found = true
		end
	end
	if found == false then
		Notes.addNotebookTab({title = "HardSaveData", body = "", color = "Black"})
	else
		local data_to_load = JSON.decode(bodyText)
		if data_to_load == nil then
			print("No previous hard save data.")
			setupConfig = {
				general = {max=true, step="0", colorSwap = false},
				pConfig= {seats=4},
				deck_Orientation="down",
				RemovePlayers=true,
				Map1550=false,
				AOR_promo=false
			}
		else
			setupConfig = data_to_load[1]
			-- print("Hard save data loaded")
		end
	end
end

function randomizebackground()
    startLuaCoroutine(self, 'randomizeBGwithDelay')
end
function randomizeBGwithDelay()
	background=getObjectFromGUID(background_GUID)
	rand=math.random(1,10)
    background.interactable=true
    wait(1)

	--Set a random background
    if rand==1 then
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage6})
    elseif rand==2 then
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage2})
    elseif rand==3 then
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage3})
    elseif rand==4 then
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage4})
    elseif rand==5 then
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage5})
    else
        background.setCustomObject({image=prenimage1})
    end
    wait(1)
    background.reload()
    wait(2)
    background.interactable=false

    return 1
end
function hardSave()
	local data_to_save = {
		setupConfig
	}

	saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
	--to remove hard saved data, delete contents of notebook, "HardSaveData"

	local i = {}
	local notebooks = Notes.getNotebookTabs()
	for k,v in pairs(notebooks) do
		if v.title == "HardSaveData" then
			i = v.index
		end
	end
	Notes.editNotebookTab({index = i, body = saved_data})
end

function wait(time)
   local start = os.time()
   repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

	local step = setupConfig.general.step

		if setupConfig.general.max==false and setupConfig.general.max ~= 0 then

function shuffle(tbl)
  for i = #tbl, 2, -1 do
    local j = math.random(i)
    tbl[i], tbl[j] = tbl[j], tbl[i]
  end
  return tbl
end
function discard_promo()
	box = getObjectsWithAllTags( {"Box"})[1]
	promos = getObjectsWithAllTags( {"Promo"})
	for x=1, #promos do
		box.putObject(promos[x])
	end
end
function moveHandZone(p, NewPos, NewRotY, Scale)

    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        handT.position = NewPos
        handT.rotation.y=NewRotY
        --handT.scale=Scale -- This code causes hands to FREAK OUT!
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end
function Arrange_Placards(color, pos, roty, object)
    forward = 10
    height=0.95
    if roty> 45 and roty < 135 then

    elseif roty> 225 and roty < 315 then
        PL_pos={x=pos.x - forward, y=height, z =pos.z }
    else
        PL_pos={x=pos.x , y=height, z =pos.z + forward}
    end
    object.setPositionSmooth(PL_pos, false, true)
    object.setRotationSmooth({0,roty+180,0}, false, true)
    object.setLock(true)
end

--Alters scale of elements and moves them
function changeTableScale(width, depth)
    --Scaling factors used to translate scale to position offset
    local width2pos = (width-1) * 18
    local depth2pos = (depth-1) * 18

    --Hand zone movement
    if checkData.move == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                moveHandZone(Player[pc], width2pos, depth2pos)
            end
        end
    end
    --Hand zone scaling
    --The button to enable this was disabled for technical reasons
    if checkData.scale == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                scaleHandZone(Player[pc], width, depth)
            end
        end
    end

    --Resizing table elements
    obj_side_top.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_bot.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_lef.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_side_rig.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_surface.setScale({width, 1, depth})

    --Moving table elements to accomodate new scale
    obj_side_lef.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_rig.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_top.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_side_bot.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg1.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg2.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg3.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg4.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    self.setPosition(obj_leg4.positionToWorld({-22.12, 8.74,-19.16}))
    --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
    --obj_surface.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,0})
end

--Move hand zone, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function moveHandZone(p, width2pos, depth2pos)
    local widthX = obj_side_rig.getPosition().x
    local depthZ = obj_side_top.getPosition().z
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            if pos.z > 0 then
                pos.z = pos.z + depth2pos - depthZ
            else
                pos.z = pos.z - depth2pos + depthZ
            end
        else
            if pos.x > 0 then
                pos.x = pos.x + width2pos - widthX
            else
                pos.x = pos.x - width2pos + widthX
            end
        end

        --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
        --pos.y = tableHeightOffset + 14

        handT.position = pos
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end


---Scales hand zones, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function scaleHandZone(p, width, depth)
    local widthFact = width / obj_side_top.getScale().x
    local depthFact = depth / obj_side_lef.getScale().x
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local scale = handT.scale
        local y = handT.rotation.y
        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            scale.x = scale.x * widthFact
        else
            scale.x = scale.x * depthFact
        end
        handT.scale = scale
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end

function setupMarketDecks()
    ---setupConfig.AOR_promo
    log(AOR_promo)
    if AOR_promo then
        setup_promo()
        wait(1)
    end
    DeckMissing=false
    --1a. Identify Supply draw decks. (Input 1 is player number. )

    DeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(Western_DeckZone_GUID)
    Decks=DeckZone.getObjects()
    if #Decks== 0 then --check for missing setup deck west
        DeckMissing=true
    end
    if DeckMissing==false then
        for _, object in ipairs(Decks) do
            if object.tag=="Deck" then
                Western_DrawDeck=object
            end
        end

        Western_DrawDeck.shuffle()
        Western_DrawDeck.setName("Western Supply")
    end
    DeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(Eastern_DeckZone_GUID)
    Decks=DeckZone.getObjects()
    if #Decks== 0 then --check for missing setup deck west
        DeckMissing=true
    end

    if DeckMissing==false then ---If there is a missing deck, exit the script
        for _, object in ipairs(Decks) do
            if object.tag=="Deck" then
                Eastern_DrawDeck=object
            end
        end
        Eastern_DrawDeck.shuffle()
        Eastern_DrawDeck.setName("Eastern Supply")
        --3. Identify Market decks & Shuffle
            DeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(WesternMarketDrawDeckZone_GUID)
            Decks=DeckZone.getObjects()
            for _, object in ipairs(Decks) do
                if object.tag=="Deck" then
                    Western_Market_Deck=object
                end
            end
            Western_Market_Deck.setName("Western Market Deck")
            DeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(EasternMarketDrawDeckZone_GUID)
            Decks=DeckZone.getObjects()
            for _, object in ipairs(Decks) do
                if object.tag=="Deck" then
                    Eastern_Market_Deck=object
                end
            end
            Eastern_Market_Deck.setName("Eastern Market Deck")
            wait(1)

        -- if Western_Market_Deck.is_face_down and Western_DrawDeck.is_face_down and Eastern_Market_Deck.is_face_down and Eastern_DrawDeck.is_face_down then --if all decks are face down, stay facedown.
        -- else --if any of the starting decks are faceup, set rotation to be face up for both.
        if Deck_Orientation=="down" then
            Western_Market_Deck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}, false, true)
            Western_DrawDeck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}, false, true)
            Eastern_Market_Deck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}, false, true)
            Eastern_DrawDeck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}, false, true)
            wait(1)
        else
            Western_Market_Deck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
            Western_DrawDeck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
            Eastern_Market_Deck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
            Eastern_DrawDeck.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, true)
            wait(1)
        end
        --2. Draw cards to the starting Decks. (setup initial 12 cards with the commets.)
        WesternMarketDrawDeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(WesternMarketDrawDeckZone_GUID)
        poss=WesternMarketDrawDeckZone.getPosition()
        if playernumber== 1 then
            decksize = 8 -- shuffle comets into 8 cards for solitare
        else
            decksize = 12 -- Shuffle comets into 12 cards.
        end
        for i=1, decksize do --simplify since faceup/down will be consisten.
            Western_DrawDeck.takeObject({ position = poss, smooth = true, flip = false, top= true})
            Eastern_DrawDeck.takeObject({ position = {poss.x, poss.y, poss.z-6.91  }, smooth = true, flip = false, top= true})
        end
        wait(2.5)
        --(3) -- Wait 2 seconds to merge the new cards into the Market decks.

        --4. Determine quantity based on number of players.
        if playernumber == 1 then
            drawnumb=math.floor(2*4)
        else
            drawnumb=math.floor(playernumber*4)
        end

        --5. Randomize the draw decks (12+ 2 comets) (or 8 in solitare)
        Western_Market_Deck.randomize()
        Eastern_Market_Deck.randomize()
        wait(2)
        --6. Draw cards to the starting Decks. (setup initial 12 cards with the commets.)
        WesternMarketDrawDeckZone=getObjectFromGUID(WesternMarketDrawDeckZone_GUID)
        poss=WesternMarketDrawDeckZone.getPosition()
        poss.y=poss.y+1
        for i=1, drawnumb do
            Western_DrawDeck.takeObject({ position = {poss.x, poss.y+1,poss.z}, smooth = true, flip = false, top= true})
            Eastern_DrawDeck.takeObject({ position = {poss.x, poss.y+1, poss.z-6.91 }, smooth = true, flip = false, top= true})
        end

        --7. Discard the remaining supply decks (to the box)
        discardbox=getObjectFromGUID(discardbox_GUID)
        local boxposs=discardbox.getPosition()
        Western_DrawDeck.setPositionSmooth({boxposs.x, boxposs.y+5, boxposs.z}, false, true)
        Eastern_DrawDeck.setPositionSmooth({boxposs.x, boxposs.y+6, boxposs.z}, false, true)

        --8. Deal 6 cards to start the market
        setupmarket2()
        broadcastToAll("Market Setup Complete", {1,1,1})
        broadcastToAll("---------------------------", {1,1,1})
    else
        broadcastToAll("A supply deck is missing. Setup Script canceled.", {1,1,1})
        broadcastToAll("---------------------------", {1,1,1})
    end
    return 1
end

        zone=getObjectFromGUID(zone_GUID)
        local objectsinzone=zone.getObjects()
        --First test to see if the zone is missing a card.

            if object.tag=="Card" then

                cardpresent=true
            end
        end
        --Now update counter based on zone being empty.
        if #objectsinzone==0 and emptyzone_min>x then
            emptyzone_min=x --Reset empty zone to an actually empty zone number. 1-6
            emptyzone_Quantity=emptyzone_Quantity+1
        elseif #objectsinzone==0 then
            emptyzone_Quantity=emptyzone_Quantity+1
        elseif #objectsinzone>0 and emptyzone_min>x and cardpresent==false then
            emptyzone_min=x --Reset empty zone to an actually empty zone number. 1-6
            emptyzone_Quantity=emptyzone_Quantity+1
        elseif #objectsinzone==0 and cardpresent==false then
            emptyzone_Quantity=emptyzone_Quantity+1
        end

    for i=1, emptyzone_Quantity do --Loop for number of empty zones.

        for y, zone_GUID in ipairs(zonelist) do

   repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Used by to find distance
function findProximity(targetPos, object)
    local objectPos = object.getPosition()
    local xDistance = targetPos.x - objectPos.x
    local zDistance = targetPos.z - objectPos.z
    local xDistanceabs = math.abs(targetPos.x - objectPos.x)
    local zDistanceabs = math.abs(targetPos.z - objectPos.z)
    local distance = xDistance^2 + zDistance^2
    return math.sqrt(distance)
end

function return_pos_offset(object, forward , right)
    -- invertside=1
    -- if object.tag=="Card" then
    --     if object.is_face_down then -- if card is facedown, then reverse right/left sides.
    --         invertside=-1
    --     end
    -- end

    distance_F = forward
    pos_targetF = object.getTransformForward()
    distance_R = right
    pos_targetR = object.getTransformRight()

    pos_current = object.getPosition()
    pos = {
        x = pos_current.x + pos_targetF.x * distance_F + pos_targetR.x * distance_R,
        y = pos_current.y + pos_targetF.y * distance_F  + pos_targetR.y * distance_R,
        z = pos_current.z + pos_targetF.z * distance_F   + pos_targetR.z * distance_R
    }
    return pos
end
